1. Purpose and Description of the WebEditor

The Oakshift WebEditor is a browser-based data editing tool designed to provide a form-based interface through which authorised users may create, modify, or otherwise manage preformatted data contained within JSON files hosted within a GitHub repository. The WebEditor is primarily intended to support websites developed or maintained by Oakshift Software and provides a means of using structured JSON files as a lightweight alternative to conventional database-backed systems and associated hosting infrastructure.

The WebEditor may allow information displayed by a website to be managed through an administrative or editorial interface without requiring the website owner to maintain a conventional database server or separate application hosting environment. Depending upon the implementation, changes made through the WebEditor may be committed directly to the relevant GitHub repository, after which the associated website may retrieve or otherwise process the updated JSON data.

The WebEditor may be provided in a standard form or may be customised, configured, branded, modified, or otherwise adapted by Oakshift Software for use with a particular website or project. Such customisations may include, without limitation, changes to forms, fields, validation, presentation, available functionality, data structures, repository configuration, or other elements required for the particular website for which the WebEditor has been supplied.
